title: Parche Par Likhe Test Ka Matlab — Deoria Guide
description: Doctor ne CBC, LFT, KFT ya RBS likha hai aur samajh nahi aa raha? Har short form ka poora naam, kaun sa test ghar se ho jaata hai, aur booking kaise karein.
keywords: Parche Par Likhe Test Ka Matlab
Doctor Ke Parche Ka Test Kaise Padhein
Blood Test Short Form Meaning Hindi
Urine RM Aur CS Me Farak
takeaways: Parche par likha zyadatar short form ek panel ka naam hota hai, ek test ka nahi — CBC me lagbhag bees number aate hain aur LFT me das ke aas-paas.
Sugar ke chaar naam chaar alag test hain: FBS khaali pet, PPBS khaane ke 2 ghante baad, RBS kabhi bhi, aur HbA1c teen mahine ka ausat. Ek ko doosre ki jagah karana report bekaar kar deta hai.
Parche par USG, X-ray, ECG ya Echo likha ho to wo sample par nahi hoti — uske liye centre jaana hi padega, aur wo hamari service me nahi hai.
Likhaai samajh na aaye to andaaza mat lagaiye. Parche ki photo booking ke waqt taiyaar rakhiye — galat test karana do baar sui ka matlab hota hai.

sections.heading: Parcha Padhna Kyun Zaroori Hai — Sabse Mehenga Test Wahi Hota Hai Jo Dobara Karana Pade
sections.lead: Galti daam me nahi, doosri baar sui lagne me hoti hai.
blocks: Deoria me aksar aisa hota hai: doctor ne parche par teen chaar short form likh diye, ghar aakar wo padhe nahi ja rahe, aur booking me jo naam yaad aaya wo likhwa diya gaya. Nateeja ye nikalta hai ki test ho gaya lekin wo nahi hua jo doctor ne maanga tha — aur poora kaam dobara karna padta hai.

Ismein sabse bada nuksan paisa nahi hai. Nuksan ye hai ki doosri baar sample dena padta hai, ek din aur nikal jaata hai, aur beemar aadmi ka ilaaj utni der ruka rehta hai. Isliye booking se pehle paanch minute parche par kharch kar dena sabse achha nivesh hai.

Neeche wo saare short form hain jo is ilaake ke parchon par sabse zyada dikhte hain, unka poora naam, aur ye ki wo sample par hote hain ya nahi. Yahan ye nahi bataya gaya ki kis number ka kya matlab hai — wo aapke doctor ka kaam hai, aur report aane ke baad ka.

blocks: Do jagah sabse zyada uljhan hoti hai. Pehli — Urine R/M aur Urine C/S. R/M aam jaanch hai; C/S me sample ko badhne diya jaata hai isliye usme 48–72 ghante lagte hain, aur wo der lab ki nahi, test ki apni hai. Doosri — dengue me NS1 aur IgM/IgG. Ye alag test hain aur bukhar ke alag dinon ke liye hain, isliye "dengue test" kehna kaafi nahi hota.
Bukhar me kis din kaun sa test sach me kaam ka hota hai — iska poora hisaab
me hai, aur peshab ki jaanch ka poora tareeka
me. Antibiotic shuru karne se pehle culture ka sample dena kyun zaroori hai, wo bhi wahin likha hai.

sections.heading: Parche Par Test Ke Saath Likhe Chhote Nishaan
sections.lead: "F", "stat", "R/O" — inka matlab test se utna hi zaroori hai.

list: "F" ya "Fasting" — sample khaali pet dena hai. Ye aam taur par sugar, lipid profile aur package ke saath likha hota hai.
"PP" — khaane ke 2 ghante baad wala sample. Iske saath aksar "F" bhi likha hota hai, yaani do sample.
"Stat" ya "urgent" — report jaldi chahiye. Booking ke waqt ye bata dijiye taaki samay ke baare me saaf baat ho sake.
"R/O" (rule out) — doctor kisi cheez ko hataana chahte hain. Ye aapke liye nahi, lab ke liye ishara hai; ise le kar ghabraane ki zaroorat nahi.
Test ke saamne likhi tareekh — us din test karana hai. Aksar dawa shuru karne ke kuch hafte baad ka follow-up aise hi likha jaata hai.

blocks: Ek cheez jo parche par nahi likhi hoti par utni hi maayne rakhti hai: aap jo dawa pehle se le rahe hain. Kuch dawaiyan aur supplement report ke number ko sach me hila dete hain, aur uska hal aksar sirf itna hota hai ki sample dene ke baad goli li jaaye.
Kaun si dawa kaun se test par asar daalti hai aur kab rukna chahiye — iska poora hisaab
me hai. Sample dene se pehle band karne ka faisla doctor ka hota hai, apne aap dawa mat rokiye.

sections.heading: Likhaai Hi Samajh Na Aa Rahi Ho To
sections.lead: Andaaza lagana sabse mehenga vikalp hai.
blocks: Haath ki likhi parchi padhna aasan nahi hota, aur ye koi sharm ki baat nahi hai. Bas ek kaam mat kijiye — andaaze se test likhwa dena. Ek jaise dikhne wale do naam bilkul alag test hote hain, aur galat test ka matlab hai doosri baar sui, doosra din, aur ilaaj me deri.

list: Parche ki saaf photo khinch lijiye — dhoop ya achhi roshni me, poora kaagaz frame me, chhaya na pade.
Booking ke waqt wo photo taiyaar rakhiye. Jo test padhe ja rahe hain wo aapko padh kar suna diye jaayenge.
Jo bilkul na khule, uske liye usi clinic par ek call kar lijiye jahan se parcha mila hai — do minute ka kaam hai.
Purani report saath rakhiye. Doctor ne follow-up likha hai to pichhli report se milaana aasan ho jaata hai.
Do doctoron ke do parche hain to dono dikhaiye — aksar dono me kuch test ek hi hote hain, aur wo dobara karane ki zaroorat nahi hoti.

note.title: Hum report ka matlab nahi batate
note.text: Ye guide sirf naam kholti hai — kaun sa short form kis test ka hai. Kaun sa test aapke liye zaroori hai, report ka matlab kya hai, aur aage kya karna hai — ye teeno aapke doctor ka kaam hai. Booking par hum itna zaroor bata dete hain ki parche ka kaun sa hissa sample par ho jaata hai aur kaun sa nahi.

faqs.question: Parche par CBC likha hai — ismein kitne test hote hain?
faqs.answer: CBC ek test ka naam nahi, ek panel ka naam hai. Complete Blood Count me lagbhag bees number aate hain — haemoglobin, RBC, WBC ki kul ginti aur unka bantwara, platelet count, aur kai indices. Ye sab ek hi sample se nikalte hain, isliye ek hi baar sui lagti hai. Iske liye fasting ki zaroorat nahi hoti, so sample din me kabhi bhi diya ja sakta hai.

faqs.question: LFT aur KFT me kya farak hai? Dono likhe hain to do sample lagenge?
faqs.answer: LFT liver ka panel hai aur KFT kidney ka — do alag panel, do alag cheezein dekhne ke liye. Lekin dono ek hi khoon ke sample se ho jaate hain, isliye dono likhe hone par bhi ek hi baar sui lagti hai. Aksar doctor inhe saath me likhte hain kyunki dawa ya lambi beemari dono par asar daal sakti hai. Dono me kya-kya aata hai wo LFT aur KFT wali guide me poora likha hai.

faqs.question: Parche par FBS aur PPBS dono likha hai — ek hi baar me ho jaayega?
faqs.answer: Nahi, ye do alag sample hain. FBS khaali pet liya jaata hai aur PPBS naashte ke theek 2 ghante baad — ek hi baar me dono nahi ho sakte. Sahi tareeka ye hai ki subah ka jaldi wala slot lijiye, khaali pet pehla sample dijiye, turant naashta kar lijiye, aur theek do ghante baad doosra sample. Booking ke waqt bata dijiye ki dono chahiye, taaki dono ka time ek saath tay ho jaaye.

faqs.question: Parche par USG ya X-ray likha hai — kya ye bhi ghar par ho jaayega?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Ultrasound, X-ray, ECG, Echo, CT aur MRI machine par hoti hain aur aapko us centre par jaana hi padega — ye ghar par kisi bhi lab se nahi hoti, aur hamari service me bhi shaamil nahi hain. Parche ka blood aur urine wala hissa ghar se ho jaata hai. Booking ke waqt parche ki photo dikha dijiye, aapko saaf bata diya jaayega ki kaun sa hissa sample par hoga aur kaun sa nahi.

faqs.question: Doctor ki likhaai samajh nahi aa rahi — kya karein?
faqs.answer: Andaaze se test mat likhwaiye; ek jaise dikhne wale do naam bilkul alag test hote hain. Parche ki saaf photo khinch lijiye aur booking ke waqt taiyaar rakhiye — jo test padhe ja rahe hain wo aapko padh kar suna diye jaayenge. Jo phir bhi na khule uske liye usi clinic par ek call sabse seedha raasta hai.

faqs.question: TFT aur T3 T4 TSH — ye alag test hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi, ek hi baat hai. TFT ka matlab Thyroid Function Test hai, aur usme aam taur par T3, T4 aur TSH teeno aate hain. Kuch parchon par sirf "TSH" likha hota hai — us haalat me sirf ek number chahiye hota hai, teeno nahi. Thyroid me fasting nahi lagti, aur ek baat dhyaan rakhiye: thyroid ki goli sample dene ke BAAD lijiye, pehle nahi.

faqs.question: Purane parche par likhe test ab bhi karwa sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Test to ho jaayega, lekin ye poochhne layak baat hai ki wo ab bhi zaroori hai ya nahi. Parcha purana ho aur beech me dawa ya haalat badal gayi ho, to doctor aaj shaayad kuch aur maangein. Operation se pehle wali report ka to samay se matlab hota hi hai — uspar alag se pre-operative guide me likha hai. Sabse seedha tareeka: purana parcha aur purani report dono doctor ko ek baar dikha lijiye.
